subject.title: [Feature]: Owner Takeover / Human Handoff for DM Auto-Reply

question: Should OpenClaw add owner/human handoff for DM auto-reply, and should the first supported scope be WhatsApp-only or a shared channel contract covering Telegram and Discord too?
rationale: The request adds channel config and delivery-suppression state that changes message behavior, so automation cannot safely choose the permanent product contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: WhatsApp Plugin-Owned First
options.body: Add the behavior to the WhatsApp plugin/config surface first, with live WhatsApp proof and a future path to generalize if users need other channels.

options.title: Shared Channel Contract
options.body: Design a common handoff API and implement WhatsApp, Telegram, and Discord together, accepting the larger compatibility and review surface.

options.title: Defer Feature
options.body: Keep current prompt/manual-pause workarounds until stronger live evidence or maintainer sponsorship justifies new config and pause-state surface.

recommendation.title: WhatsApp Plugin-Owned First
recommendation.body: Add the behavior to the WhatsApp plugin/config surface first, with live WhatsApp proof and a future path to generalize if users need other channels.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history puts the central WhatsApp config/schema and channel dispatch surfaces in this contributor's orbit, and the decision spans channel config policy.
